jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As Senior Clinical Genetics Data Scientist, you will turn human genetic evidence into clear recommendations that guide clinical development decisions. You will lead defined projects that combine trial and population genetic data with clinical outcomes and molecular measurements. Your work will help explain disease biology, understand why people respond differently to treatment and identify where patient stratification, or asset differentiation could matter. It helps teams decide with confidence, for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You are an independent, systematic scientist with sound judgement, who communicates uncertainty openly, acts on feedback and sees work through to its outcome.

• A PhD in statistical genetics, genetic epidemiology, bioinformatics or a related quantitative discipline; or a relevant master’s degree with equivalent demonstrated research and applied experience.

• Demonstrated independent ownership of complex human genetics projects, from study design and data preparation to robust interpretation and communication of results.

• Strong, hands-on experience in GWAS design, execution and interpretation, including linkage disequilibrium, population structure, relatedness, multiple testing, power and validation.

• Proficiency in R and/or Python, Linux and genetics tools such as PLINK, BCFtools, GATK, REGENIE, SAIGE or equivalent, with reproducible programming, version control, documentation and quality review.

• Practical experience processing SNP array and WGS data, including quality control, genotype harmonisation, phasing and imputation, variant calling, filtering and functional annotation.

• Hands-on experience conducting and interpreting pQTL analyses, including cis and trans mapping, multiple-testing control and integration with GWAS or colocalisation evidence.

• The ability to coordinate stakeholders, manage project risks and dependencies, and present complex findings clearly in English to audiences with different technical backgrounds.

Desirable, but not essential:

Experience in clinical trial genetics, pharmacogenetics or clinical development, particularly in cardiometabolic, obesity or renal disease; rare-variant and gene-based tests, genetic risk prediction or advanced causal inference; or work with secure cloud computing, biobank-scale resources and regulated analytical environments.

What you’ll do

You will own project outcomes from the scientific question to validated results and practical recommendations.

• Plan and run GWAS, pQTL and related analyses of disease phenotypes, clinical endpoints, biomarkers and treatment response, using trial and external cohort data.

• Prepare SNP array and whole-genome sequencing data into analysis-ready datasets, and use fine-mapping, colocalisation and causal inference to prioritise plausible variants, genes, pathways and biomarkers.

• Investigate pharmacogenetic associations and genetically informed subgroups, separating prognostic signals from evidence of differential treatment benefit.

• Turn findings into decision-focused reports and presentations, with clear uncertainty and limitations, and contribute genetics content to publications and regulatory documents.

• Build documented, version-controlled workflows, mentor colleagues through code review and feedback, and use genetic and clinical data within approved consent, governance and quality requirements.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Clinical Omics Sciences, part of Translational & Clinical Omics in Research & Development. Here, colleagues explore scientific ideas and advance them towards clinical testing, bringing together curiosity, data, technology and collaboration.

Your closest partners will be Clinical Development Teams, translational scientists, human genetics researchers, biostatisticians, data managers and data engineers. You will also coordinate agreed work with external collaborators and suppliers. You will explain your technical choices in accessible language, build alignment on the question, deliverables and decision, and speak up early when something stalls.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to determine and execute the analytical approach for your projects, within agreed objectives and quality requirements. You will be supported to perform at your best, make your voice heard and grow through practical project experience, scientific feedback and relevant learning offerings. You will also help raise the standard for the whole team by shaping shared workflows, templates and methods.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 to

956,900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

Start now

We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

Job Title: AI Engineer

Department: Quality AI & Data Enterprise IT & Quality

Location: Ballerup, Denmark

Your impact begins here

As AI Engineer in Quality AI & Data, you will build AI applications and agents that help colleagues work faster and with greater clarity across Novo’s quality processes. You will take your work from first prototype to a product people use every day, shaped with the users and process experts who know the workflows best. Your work supports high quality across Novo, and helps treatments reach people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

• A relevant university degree.

• Built and deployed working software, and the ability to explain the technical decisions you made, the problems you met and what you learned.

• Strong programming skills in Python or another relevant language, with experience of APIs, databases and cloud services.

• Practical experience building LLM applications and agentic pipelines, including context management, retrieval, tool use and orchestration.

• Experience building evaluations from scratch: defining success with domain experts, creating representative test cases, automating checks and investigating failures across multistep workflows.

• The ability to turn an exploratory prototype into software that others can operate, maintain and improve.

• Ownership when requirements are incomplete: you test assumptions early and know when to ask for input.

• Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain technical choices to people with different expertise.

• Interest in applying AI to pharmaceutical quality.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience with GxP software or other regulated environments.

What you’ll do

You will own the AI applications and agents you build, from initial design through deployment and operation.

• Design and build agents, including orchestration, retrieval, tool use and integrations with enterprise systems and data sources.

• Build the software around the AI, such as APIs, data processing and application components, so the result is a usable product.

• Work directly with users and process experts to understand their workflows, test prototypes and improve based on their feedback.

• Develop evaluation datasets and automated evaluations that cover individual components and complete agent workflows.

• Use evaluations, regression tests and production feedback to investigate failures and assess changes to models, prompts, tools and orchestration.

• Apply sound engineering practices, including code review, automated testing, version control, deployment and monitoring.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Quality AI & Data, part of Enterprise IT & Quality, where colleagues work across the Novo value chain, stay close to stakeholders and help deliver trusted technology and high quality. [Insert hiring manager and team details.]

Your partners will include fellow engineers, process experts and end users, as well as senior management. The scope is global across Novo Quality processes, so you will build relationships across functions, units and geographies. You will present clear analyses, recommendations and progress updates that help managers make decisions, and you will help simplify ways of working and improve the user experience across the department. The position is based in Ballerup, Denmark.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to act independently within your scope and to take ownership of what you build. You will be challenged with complex problems, and supported by colleagues who share curiosity and a drive to raise the bar. You will grow by working at the forefront of AI and technology, applied to a regulated, high-stakes domain, and by learning from users and experts across Novo.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking a Structural Engineer Consultant to support Wind Turbine (WTG) and Balance of Plant (BoP) engineering on offshore wind projects, with a focus on Wind Turbine Components, jacket foundation design, scour and scour protection, and cable mechanical engineering.

Introducing the WTG & BoP Engineering Team

You will become part of our WTG & BoP Engineering team, where we work collaboratively to support renewable energy projects around the world. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of WTG & BoP Engineering and work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As a Structural Engineer Consultant, you will contribute to the successful development, construction, and operation of our clients’ wind projects. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting End of Warranties activities, technical due diligence, and asset management topics for clients throughout the development, construction, and operational phases of wind farms.

• Providing engineering expertise across both WTG and BoP systems, including turbine components, jacket foundations, scour protection, inter-array and export cables, offshore substations, and associated infrastructure.

• Leading the engineering activities related to foundation, scour protection, and cable work packages for offshore wind projects, from development and procurement through construction and into operations.

• Acting as a trusted technical advisor on jacket foundation design and scour management, reviewing foundation and scour protection solutions from design basis through detailed design, installation, and monitoring to ensure safe, robust, and cost-effective performance.

• Providing cable mechanical engineering support, including inter-array and export cable routing, burial and protection, cable protection systems, crossings, and the cable - foundation interface.

• Identifying, assessing, and mitigating technical risks related to turbine components, foundations, scour, cables, and asset integrity, and maintaining the project technical risk register.

• Following up on the certification process and managing interfaces with certification bodies to ensure that designs and deliverables meet the relevant standards and requirements.

• Contributing to the development of best practices and knowledge sharing across PEAK Wind’s offshore engineering services.

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Mechanical, Structural, Civil, Geotechnical, or Offshore Engineering, or similar.

• A minimum of 5 years post-education professional experience in offshore wind, the wider offshore industry, or another complex environment.

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written.

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross - functional team.

• Solid understanding of WTG components, including their function, common failure modes, and repair methodologies

• Solid understanding of the offshore wind foundation design process, particularly for jacket structures, including the impact of scour and the design of scour protection.

• Knowledge of subsea cable systems and cable mechanical engineering, such as burial and protection, cable protection systems, crossings, and the cable - foundation interface.

• Good knowledge of offshore wind EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) as well as O&M (Operations and Maintenance), including how design and installation choices affect long - term operation of the asset.

• Familiarity with offshore wind industry standards and certification frameworks, such as DNV standards, IEC, IECRE, and Eurocodes.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

Your impact begins here

Help shape how Novo turns strategy into results. As Senior Organisational Development Partner, you will independently lead complex organisation design assignments across functions and Executive Vice President (EVP) areas, from defining the challenge to following through on implementation and outcomes. You will help senior leaders build the capabilities, accountabilities and ways of working needed to compete, so teams can focus on delivering for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

• A relevant master’s degree in business, strategy, organisation, HR or a related field.

• Typically, 5–8 years of relevant experience in organisational development or design, consulting, or strategic HR with substantial OD delivery.

• A track record of independently leading complex organisational assignments from problem definition and design through implementation follow-up.

• Credibility advising senior business leaders and working with strategy and HR stakeholders in a global organisation.

• Strong analytical and facilitation skills, with the ability to turn complex issues into clear recommendations and deliver results through others.

• Experience improving OD approaches and building capability through practical guidance, facilitation and coaching.

• Strategic judgement and initiative, with the confidence to challenge constructively, reconcile competing priorities and balance analytical rigour with practical execution.

• An interest in how AI changes work, roles and organisational capabilities; practical experience in this area is an advantage.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience building organisational capabilities through mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

What you’ll do

You will combine strategic advice with hands-on delivery, taking an enterprise perspective while addressing the needs of individual business areas.

• Frame complex organisational challenges with business leaders, HR Business Partners and strategy colleagues. Define the case for change, design principles and measures of success.

• Develop organisation and operating model options that connect strategy and capabilities with structures, processes, people and measures of performance. Make trade-offs and recommendations clear.

• Combine organisational data and business insight into concise recommendations and clear decision requests for senior leaders, partnering with People Analytics on analytical needs.

• Lead assignments through design and implementation planning. Establish governance, manage risks and dependencies, agree implementation ownership with business leaders and HR Business Partners, and follow up on adoption and results.

• Facilitate senior leadership discussions and contribute expertise to organisational reviews, workforce segmentation and job architecture.

• Strengthen OD practice by developing reusable methods and tools, building OD capability among leaders and HR Business Partners, and coaching OD colleagues.

• You will shape how the organisation and hence operating model is best set up to deliver on the strategy, and you will see your work through to results.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Organisational Development and M&A team in People, Organisation & Corporate Affairs (POCA), reporting directly to the Head of Organisational Development and M&A. You will be a trusted adviser to your manager and colleagues and support the POCA Business Partnering Leadership Team on agreed OD priorities.

Your partners will include business leaders, Corporate Strategy, strategy colleagues across EVP areas, HR Business Partners, People Analytics, Centres of Excellence and executive offices/EAs. You will be based at headquarters in Denmark and work across functions, EVP areas and geographies.

What you can expect here

You will have the independence to shape assignments, recommend a direction and see your work through to results. The role offers exposure across the Novo value chain and the opportunity to influence both organisational decisions and how we practise OD.

We value thoughtful challenge, shared ownership and high-quality delivery. You will have clear expectations, support from colleagues and room to make your voice heard. We follow through on decisions and approach organisational change with care for people, integrity and respect for quality.

What we offer

At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn strategy into organisational progress across Novo, apply for the Senior Organisational Development Partner role by 23 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

**Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

**You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr81,720.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Agnieszka Boszczar

**The Impact You'll Make

**Join a global Infrastructure Operations team that keeps Danfoss connected, secure, and running smoothly across manufacturing plants, offices, and data centers throughout the EMEA region. Your expertise will help ensure reliable network services that support business continuity and operational excellence.

In this role, you will combine hands-on troubleshooting with strategic infrastructure improvements. From resolving complex network challenges to implementing new technologies, your work will directly contribute to a modern, secure, and high-performing IT environment.

If you enjoy working with enterprise networks, collaborating with global teams, and making a visible impact on critical business operations, this is an exciting opportunity to grow your career at Danfoss.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Support and maintain enterprise network infrastructure across EMEA, ensuring stable, secure, and reliable connectivity for manufacturing sites, offices, and data centers.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex routing, switching, wireless, and network connectivity issues while contributing to major incident and problem management activities.

• Deliver and support network infrastructure projects, including lifecycle upgrades, office relocations, site expansions, and new site deployments.

• Drive continuous improvement by identifying optimization opportunities, performing root cause analysis, and contributing to automation initiatives.

• Create and maintain high-quality network documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge resources that support efficient operations and team collaboration.

**What We're Looking For

**

• 3+ years of experience as a Network Engineer supporting enterprise-scale network environments.

• Strong knowledge of LAN/WAN networking, routing (OSPF, BGP), VLANs, STP, subnetting, VPN technologies, wireless networking, and network security concepts.

• Hands-on experience with Aruba switches, Aruba Wireless, Aruba Central, ClearPass, and network monitoring tools.

• Experience installing, upgrading, and supporting network infrastructure in complex business environments.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

• Excellent communication in English language (Danish is an asset); stakeholder collaboration skills; multicultural experience.

• Experience with SD-WAN, scripting, automation, ITIL practices, or manufacturing environments is an advantage.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits on top of your salary. More information shall be provided during the recruitment process.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Product Owner for Open Banking in Customer and Sector Integrations Tribe
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Open Banking is reshaping how customers connect with their banks, and Danske Bank is at the centre of that shift. As a Product Owner in the Customer and Sector Integrations Tribe, you will help define how businesses and developers integrate with us through regulatory and premium APIs. You will gain real ownership over a product that sits at the heart of our Forward 28 strategy.

**What You Will Be Doing

**The Customer and Sector Integrations Tribe is a team of around 150 colleagues spread across the Nordics, Lithuania, and India, working to automate and streamline financial interactions between customers, Danske Bank, the financial sector, and authorities. You will work closely with your squad and a wide range of stakeholders to shape an Open Banking platform that is available, scalable, stable, and resilient. The work is genuinely complex, and the decisions you make will shape how the next generation of integrations, whether direct, via third parties, or via AI, come to life.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Translating vision and strategy into clear backlog priorities and roadmaps

• Turning customer needs, business objectives, and technical possibilities into tangible increments

• Building and maintaining strong relationships with stakeholders across the organisation

• Creating a collaborative and supportive environment where your squad can do their best work

• Identifying opportunities to apply AI to improve both the product and ways of working

**About You

**

• Five or more years of experience in product development, including a leadership dimension

• Ability to make complex topics clear and actionable for different audiences

• Strong interpersonal skills and a natural collaborator

• Commercial mindset with the ability to connect customer needs to business value

• Comfortable making decisions in ambiguous situations

• Experience working with AI tools or applying AI thinking in practice

Experience from financial services or a regulated industry would be a welcome addition. We are equally interested in candidates who bring a fresh perspective from adjacent sectors.

**What We Offer You

**This position can be located both in Lithuania and Denmark. If the position is located in Lithuania the monthly salary range from 4160 EUR to 6240 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).

Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package (benefits are only valid for Lithuania the same as the salary ranges) which includes:

• Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.

• Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.

• Hybrid working conditions: Work from home up to two days a week; home office budget (after the probation period); modern Danske Campus workplace developed with anthropologist for the best employee experience.

• Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.

• Monetary compensation package: accidents & critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events, travel insurance; IIIrd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.

See all the benefits HERE**.

**Your job function (position) in the job contract will be Product Management.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply when you are ready. If you have questions about the role, please reach out to Thorbjørn Tavs Søndergaard, Cluster Lead, API Integration, at thsn@danskebank.dk.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Entry IT Specialist, Power BI & Data Engineering - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by turning data into reliable insights and practical solutions for commercial teams?

Do you enjoy combining Power BI development with hands-on support and a growing understanding of Azure data engineering?

Join our Retail Product Team in Commercial IT & Digital and help develop, operate and improve data and reporting solutions used across Arla’s commercial organization. Our portfolio supports areas such as Trade Promotion Management, Net Revenue Management, Key Account Management and Retail Execution.

You will work with Power BI solutions built on commercial datasets covering areas such as electronic point-of-sale data, sales, products and customers. You will also build your understanding of the Azure-based data pipelines and data products that provide the foundation for these insights.

How You Will Make An Impact

As our Entry IT Specialist within Retail, your initial focus will be developing, maintaining and supporting Power BI reports and dashboards. Alongside this, you will gradually contribute to selected data engineering activities and strengthen your understanding of the end-to-end data flow from source systems and Azure pipelines to business-facing reporting.

This is a varied and operational role. Your work will shift between development, troubleshooting, incident response, user support and continuous improvement. You will work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Architects and other IT colleagues, with support and guidance matched to your experience.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

• Develop, enhance and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards and semantic models based on business needs.

• Work with Power BI Desktop, Power Query, DAX and SQL to create clear, reliable and user-friendly reporting solutions.

• Support existing Power BI solutions, including investigating incidents, troubleshooting data issues and communicating progress to users and stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, clarify requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.

• Contribute to data quality checks, testing, documentation, deployment and structured handover of new or changed solutions.

• Understand and monitor the upstream data flows that supply Power BI solutions, and help identify whether issues originate in the report, data model or data pipeline.

• Contribute to selected Azure data engineering tasks, such as data ingestion, transformation, orchestration and pipeline maintenance, with guidance from experienced colleagues.

• Participate in Agile planning, backlog refinement, code reviews and continuous improvement activities across the Retail Product Team.

• Help improve operational stability through better monitoring, documentation, reusable solutions and root-cause resolution.

What Will Make You Successful

You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of relevant experience. More important than knowing every technology from day one is that you have a solid analytical foundation, enjoy solving real operational problems and are motivated to develop across both business intelligence and data engineering.

We Imagine That You Bring

• A relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Practical knowledge of Power BI, including Power BI Desktop, Power Query, data modelling and basic DAX. This may come from work, an internship, studies or personal projects.

• Working knowledge of SQL and an understanding of relational data, data quality and analytical modelling.

• An interest in Azure data platforms and a desire to learn technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake and Databricks.

• Basic programming experience, preferably with Python or PySpark, is an advantage.

• An understanding of ETL/ELT, data pipelines, Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD or automated testing is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• The ability to communicate clearly in English and collaborate with both technical colleagues and business stakeholders.

Most importantly, you are curious, structured and hands-on. You take responsibility for following tasks through, are comfortable asking for support when needed and enjoy a role where priorities can move between planned development and urgent operational needs. You are motivated by learning, but also by making existing solutions work reliably for their users.

What do we offer?

You will join a collaborative Retail Product Team with a broad commercial solution landscape and strong opportunities to learn across reporting, data engineering and product operations. You will gain practical experience with business-critical data and solutions while working closely with experienced specialists, architects and commercial stakeholders.

• A role with Power BI as the initial focus and a clear opportunity to build capabilities in Azure data engineering over time.

• Varied work across development, support, incident handling and continuous improvement rather than a narrow single-technology role.

• Structured onboarding, professional guidance and room to take increasing ownership as your experience grows.

• Exposure to commercial processes and solutions within Trade Promotion Management, Net Revenue Management, Key Account Management and Retail Execution.

• An international and collaborative working environment with flexibility and opportunities for professional development.

Would you like to join us?

If you are motivated by combining data, reporting and technology, and want to grow into a versatile specialist who can develop solutions and support them in daily operation, we would like to hear from you.

Please apply as soon as possible, as we process applications on a continuous basis.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Do you want to be at the forefront of managing initiatives that enable next-generation Laser Systems for quantum computers, sensors, and communication systems? Do you thrive on turning complex challenges into structured plans and delivering results that push the boundaries of innovation?

**Then this job as Technical Project Manager for Quantum Systems at Hamamatsu Photonics may be the right job for you!

Being in the middle of the second quantum revolution, this is a great time to join us. Our continued success has set us on an exciting growth path—not just in Denmark, but across our global organization. Hamamatsu Photonics, is an inspiring place to work, where we encourage both personal and career development.

You will join a highly skilled and dedicated team of engineers and scientists and play a key role in ensuring successful delivery of projects that develop advanced laser systems and accessories for top-tier quantum technology customers.

**The Role:

**As a member of our Quantum Systems engineering team, you will lead the development, assembly, and testing of custom laser system products and prototypes based on ultra-stable fiber lasers. You interface with sales and support teams to provide updates on product developments and technical advice on customer enquiries as well as assisting with after sales support and repairs/upgrades.

**We are passionate about Quantum Technology! If you are enthusiastic about quantum technologies and computing too, in this position you will:

**

• Lead and manage technical projects from concept to delivery, ensuring timelines, budgets, and quality standards are met following Hamamatsu Photonics Product and Prototype development processes

• Coordinate cross-functional teams of optical, mechanical and electronics engineers, commercial stake holders, and production specialists to achieve project goals

• Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders and external customers, providing clear communication and progress updates.

• Develop project plans, risk assessments, and resource allocations to ensure smooth execution.

• Support strategic decision-making by providing insights on project feasibility, technical challenges, and customer requirements.

**More about you:

**As a strong candidate for this position, we hope that you can tick all or most of the following boxes:

• A relevant educational qualification (Master level) is required, preferably gained within a photonics research environment

• Strong background in project management within high-tech or engineering environments (ideally in an industrial context)

• Experience with complex, multi-disciplinary projects, ideally in photonics, optics, or quantum technologies.

• Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders at all levels.

• Familiarity with project management tools and methodologies (e.g. PRINCE or similar).

• A proactive mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment

• Fluent in English (written and spoken)

• Willingness to travel up to 10% annually, potentially globally

We want you to feel supported, both at work and outside it. Our benefits include:

• A 12% employer-paid pension contribution and health insurance.

• An annual bonus program.

• 25 days of paid vacation, plus five additional days once you have been with us for nine months.

• Access to thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning.

• Wellbeing initiatives and an annual flu vaccination.

• Freshly prepared meals from our subsidised on-site canteen.

• Free parking at our Birkerød site.

• Social activities through our Employee Association.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the mergers with Axioma and Domos, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Market Units are where SimCorp meets its clients – and the commercial engine behind them is what turns strategy into growth. As Head of Global Commercial, you will lead the global commercial organisation that powers our front-line Market Unit teams, including Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Marketing.

Reporting to Oliver Johnson, Chief Revenue Officer, and working as a peer to our regional Managing Directors, you will lead a commercial transformation with a clear top-line focus: making our Market Units more effective, more productive and better equipped to win. The role is based in EMEA – in London, Copenhagen or Frankfurt.

Success in this role means Market Units that spend more of their time with clients, a commercial organisation where AI and data are part of how every team works, and a commercial model that scales with SimCorp’s growth.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Commercial transformation: Define and lead a transformation agenda that makes SimCorp’s Market Units across all regions more efficient, scalable and growth-oriented

• Commercial organisation: Lead and develop Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Marketing, ensuring each function directly supports front-line performance

• Top-line growth: Improve pipeline generation, sales productivity, win rates and deal velocity across the Market Units

• Operating model: Review and optimise the commercial team set-up and operating model, so people, resources and investment are focused on the highest-impact growth opportunities

• AI and data: Embed AI, automation and data-driven insight into commercial processes – from forecasting and territory planning to enablement and marketing execution

• Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, partner with regional Managing Directors and Market Unit leaders, and establish a commercial cadence and KPIs that give leadership clear transparency on performance

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:

• Experience leading a commercial team transformation end-to-end, with measurable improvements in productivity and growth

• Significant experience driving commercial performance and value creation; scaled experience in Financial Services, Private Equity or Software

• Deep knowledge of financial services and the investment management software market, including the buy-side client landscape, market dynamics and competitors

• Senior leadership of commercial functions such as Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and/or Marketing, across multiple regions and cultures

• An AI-native mindset, with hands-on experience applying AI, automation and modern go-to-market tooling to commercial teams

• Leadership that builds and inspires high-performing teams, makes difficult decisions with clarity and empathy, and influences senior stakeholders in a matrix organisation

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Michael Paterson, Talent Acquisition Partner, at MLPN@SimCorp.com . If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.description:
Enterprise Sales Development Representative — Italian Speaking, South Pod EMEAHelp us create qualified enterprise pipeline that protects the world's factory floors

Start date: January 1, 2027

At Secomea, our Sales Development team plays a critical role in creating and developing new business opportunities across manufacturers, machine builders and industrial organizations.

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative for our South Pod, with a focus on Italy, you'll work closely with Territory Managers and the wider commercial team to identify the right accounts, engage relevant stakeholders and develop opportunities into qualified enterprise pipeline.

Your primary focus will be supporting our growth across Italy and the Southern European markets.

This is not simply an appointment-setting role. We want our SDRs to understand the businesses they target, recognize relevant market and customer signals, and have credible conversations with prospects.

You'll use modern sales technology and AI to make research, preparation and personalization more effective—giving you more time to focus on developing business and engaging customers.

What you'll do

• 
Generate qualified pipeline across named enterprise accounts within the Southern Europe territory

• 
Research and prioritize target accounts based on fit, business signals and relevant triggers

• 
Develop outbound, inbound and partner-sourced opportunities

• 
Engage prospects through calls, email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels

• 
Build relationships across multiple stakeholders, including OT, Security, Operations, IT and business leaders

• 
Run initial discovery to understand business challenges, priorities, timing and potential opportunities

• 
Work strategically with Territory Managers on target accounts and territory priorities

• 
Collaborate with Partner Managers, Marketing and Pre-Sales to develop opportunities

• 
Create high-quality Sales Accepted Opportunities and ensure a strong handover to the Territory Manager

• 
Use AI and sales technology to support account research, preparation and relevant outreach

• 
Maintain accurate account, activity and opportunity information in Salesforce

What we're looking for

Commercial curiosity

You're interested in understanding how companies operate, what challenges they're facing and where there may be an opportunity to create value.

You don't just ask, "Who can I book a meeting with?" You want to understand why this company, why this person and why now.

Strong communication

You're comfortable starting conversations with new people, whether that's over the phone, email, LinkedIn or in a meeting.

You can communicate clearly, ask good questions and adapt your approach depending on who you're speaking with.

Fluent, professional-level Italian and English, both written and spoken, is required for this role, as you'll be prospecting, conducting discovery and communicating with senior stakeholders across the Italy and Southern European markets.

Dutch language skills are a strong advantage, but not required.

Account-based thinking

You understand—or want to learn—how enterprise sales differs from high-volume prospecting.

You're comfortable researching accounts, identifying multiple relevant stakeholders and developing different ways into an organization rather than relying on a single contact.

Business acumen

You're interested in learning about manufacturing, industrial operations and cybersecurity and can connect technology to business outcomes such as uptime, productivity, service efficiency, risk and compliance.

AI & digital fluency

You're comfortable using modern technology to work smarter.

Experience with generative AI, sales intelligence or prospecting tools is an advantage, but you don't need to be an AI expert. What's more important is curiosity, good judgment and the willingness to learn how these tools can improve your research and sales effectiveness.

Drive and discipline

You're proactive, resilient and comfortable taking ownership of your territory and pipeline.

At the same time, you understand that enterprise sales requires discipline: following up, keeping CRM data accurate, documenting what you've learned and consistently delivering on commitments.

How we measure success

Success in this role is about creating quality pipeline—not simply generating activity.

You'll be measured on areas including:

• 
Qualified opportunities created

• 
Pipeline generated

• 
Qualified meetings booked and held

• 
Quality and conversion of opportunities

• 
Development of target enterprise accounts

• 
Collaboration with Territory Managers and partners

• 
Consistent use of our sales processes and tools

What success looks like at Secomea

Our strongest Enterprise SDRs are account-first, curious and commercially minded.

They research before they reach out. They look for real reasons to engage. They build relationships across an organization rather than relying on one contact. They use technology intelligently, but know that great conversations and human judgment ultimately create opportunities.

Most importantly, they see themselves as business developers—not appointment setters.

If you're excited about developing your enterprise sales career while working at the intersection of industrial technology, cybersecurity and modern sales, we'd like to hear from you.

**

• Experience with in vitro ADME assays such as metabolic stability, metabolite identification, drug-drug interactions, absorption/permeability and transporters

**Your new team

We bond through curiosity and playfulness as a team, allowing ourselves to challenge common thinking and drive future innovation. Join us and let’s bond and be bold.

**Preferred qualifications:

**
